title: Unpinned model reference
what: A floating alias such as a -latest tag resolves to whatever the provider currently serves. Re-running months later silently uses a different judge.
why_invisible: Everything succeeds. The numbers simply move, and nothing in the output says why.
detection: Every run records the resolved dated snapshot, not the requested name, in the run config and on every record the run produces.
evidence: Checked against the provider's model list: a -latest alias reports a floating label as its version, while a dated model reports the snapshot it is pinned to.
